description: Adfærd og rettigheder testes mod elevens faktiske database.

assertions.sql: SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='v_public_leaderboard' ORDER BY ordinal_position
assertions.message: Viewet viser kun display_name og wins

assertions.sql: SELECT display_name, wins FROM v_public_leaderboard ORDER BY display_name
SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_class c CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(COALESCE(c.relacl, acldefault('r',c.relowner))) a WHERE c.oid='public.player_profiles'::regclass AND a.grantee=0
assertions.message: PUBLIC har ingen rettigheder på de private profiler

assertions.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_class c CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(COALESCE(c.relacl, acldefault('r',c.relowner))) a WHERE c.oid='public.v_public_leaderboard'::regclass AND a.grantee=0 AND a.privilege_type='SELECT'

SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_class c CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(COALESCE(c.relacl, acldefault('r',c.relowner))) a WHERE c.oid='public.v_public_leaderboard'::regclass AND a.grantee=0 AND a.privilege_type<>'SELECT'
assertions.message: PUBLIC har ingen skriverettigheder på viewet

assertions.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_rewrite r JOIN pg_depend d ON d.classid='pg_rewrite'::regclass AND d.objid=r.oid WHERE r.ev_class='public.v_public_leaderboard'::regclass AND d.refobjid='public.player_profiles'::regclass)
